messages:
zoe-cs: Hey team — enterprise customer 'CartoPay' opened a CR that started ~1h after today's rollout. They say the assistant is inventing product pricing and a fake support email. Example prompt they sent:

zoe-cs: "What's CartoPay Pro monthly price and how to get enterprise support?"

zoe-cs: Response (from our API):
\```
Pro: $9/month (billed monthly). Contact enterprise@cartopay-support.com for SLAs.\```

zoe-cs: Both pieces are wrong — CartoPay uses usage-based pricing and their support is help@cartopay.com. Customer insists this behaviour wasn't happening before the deploy. Escalating, can we triage? :rotating_light:

sam-ml: Thanks — can you paste the full API call (sanitized) and which model variant they were routed to? Also was this from Hosted or Dedicated?

zoe-cs: Hosted. Here's the sanitized request we have from their logs (only headers trimmed):

zoe-cs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v2-fastpath-q4","input":"What's CartoPay Pro monthly price and how to get enterprise support?"}' 
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

zoe-cs: Response body we captured (exact):

zoe-cs: ```json
{"id":"resp_abc123","output":"Pro: $9/month (billed monthly). Contact enterprise@cartopay-support.com for SLAs."}
```

maria-prod: Noted — we did swap traffic to rwd-v2-fastpath-q4 as part of this morning's latency rollouts at 10:12 UTC. Canary was 20% -> 60% by 10:45. deploy-bot: "rollout rwd-v2-fastpath-q4 started 2026-03-17T10:12:03Z"

deploy-bot: rollout event id: r-20260317-42, canary steps logged.

anthony-oncall: Can we reproduce deterministically? Sam, might be quantization/opt path introducing bias when shorter context or with caching. Could be prefix caching returning stale prompt completions for known customers.

sam-ml: Agree we should A/B. Zoe, can you rerun the same request but force model=rwd-v2-stable in their org (you can do that on our console routing override) and share outputs? Also include tokenization length and any prompt system messages.

zoe-cs: Doing that now for CartoPay. Will paste both outputs.

zoe-cs: rwd-v2-fastpath-q4 output (again): 

zoe-cs: ```
Pro: $9/month (billed monthly). Contact enterprise@cartopay-support.com for SLAs.
```

zoe-cs: rwd-v2-stable output: 

zoe-cs: ```
CartoPay uses usage-based pricing for Pro tier; pricing varies by usage. For enterprise support, contact help@cartopay.com or see https://cartopay.com/support for SLAs.
```

sam-ml: This is a clear regression in assertiveness & factual grounding in the fastpath variant. The stable model hedges and points to docs — correct. Fastpath is confidently inventing. Can you also include the model config used (temperature, top_p, max_tokens)?

zoe-cs: Both requests used default customer settings: temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0, max_tokens 120. No system message beyond default role.

maria-prod: We prioritized latency by enabling a JIT kernel and int8 quantization for fastpath on several instance types. That was part of the perf patch rolled at 10:12. Could be that quantization/optimized kernels made the model more prone to confident fabrication on shortQA.

sam-ml: Action items: 1) rollback routing for CartoPay to rwd-v2-stable immediately (maria-prod can do a per-org route override) 2) run differential checks on 1000 sample QA prompts between stable and fastpath to quantify rate of assertive false facts 3) capture token-level logits if possible for a few repro cases to see calibration shift.

maria-prod: Will apply per-org override now and pause further canary expansion until ML signoff. Doing override -> patching routing table for org cartopay -> verified. :thumbsup:

zoe-cs: Customer confirmed after override they're seeing stable-like replies again. They want postmortem + mitigation plan before we re-enable the variant. They also asked for an incident severity escalation to their AM.

anthony-oncall: I'll collect inference logs for the two traces and request a dump of KV-cache state and quantization metadata for the instance that served their fastpath request. Sam, can you own the dif-check and leftover repro instrumentation?

sam-ml: Taking dif-check. I'll run an initial 1k prompt sample overnight against both variants and run automated assertion checks (entity hallucination, numeric drift, invented emails/URLs). Will share a short report morning 2026-03-18.

zoe-cs: Thanks. Please include any short-term mitigations (e.g., routing shield to stable for similar high-value orgs, reduce canary percent, disable int8 on fastpath) in the report.

maria-prod: Noted. Paused canary at 60% and flagged the rollout. Ops alert created: RL-2175012345.

deploy-bot: "rollout rwd-v2-fastpath-q4 paused at 60% due to policy: factuality-regression-detected"

anthony-oncall: Filing an SEV ticket and assigning to ML/Runtime. Will attach traces. :fire:

zoe-cs: I'll keep the customer updated and request any additional examples they have. Thanks everyone, priority = high.

sam-ml: Quick hypothesis note: optimized kernels + quantization can change softmax logits scaling; at temp 0 this may amplify argmax bias toward short, confident tokens. If confirmed, mitigation options: restore fp16 path for QA routing, recalibrate logits temperature post-quantization, or add a grounding step that forces links to docs when the model asserts concrete facts about pricing/contacts.

zoe-cs: Copy — will relay to CartoPay.

maria-prod: I'll leave the per-org override in place until ML gives green light.

zoe-cs: Closing loop once we have the differential report. :eyes:
